title: Password reset / recovery abuse
summary: Abuse reset token handling, host header, or account enumeration on recovery flows.
steps: Map forgot-password / reset endpoints and response differences (enum).
Request reset; inspect token in email link params, responses, or logs if in scope.
Test host-header / poisoned link generation when reset emails include URLs.
Token: reuse, predictability, not binding to user, no expiry.
On PASS: account takeover path or reliable user enumeration with impact notes.
kill_signals: Generic responses, strong tokens, no host poison
